title: MMA Mania Asks Fighters About Alien Life
excerpt: MMA Mania opened its Monday thread with a question about extraterrestrial life, inviting fans and fighters to weigh in on UFOs and aliens.
content:
MMA Mania opened its Monday open thread with an unusual question for fight fans: do you believe aliens are out there?

The site's Tim Edwards posed the question in its daily discussion post, asking readers to share their views on extraterrestrial life and favorite alien-themed movies, TV shows, and games. Edwards noted he had to include the GOAT in any alien discussion, though he did not specify which fighter he was referencing.

Fight News Mixed With UFO Talk

The thread appeared alongside fight updates, including new smoke around a potential Volkanovski versus Gaethje matchup and Dana White dismissing concerns about recent security incidents.

MMA Mania also promoted its new mobile app for iOS and Android, allowing fans to follow combat sports coverage in one place. The open thread format lets the site's community discuss topics beyond cage results and fight announcements.
